title: Raku Workshop
bring: bisqued pots (2-4 medium pieces) or clay to bisque
summary: Hands-on outdoor raku firing workshop on October 2nd. Glazing, kiln climbing, and reduction chamber experience included. Participants bring bisqued pots or make pots from provided clay, bisque them, glaze, and fire with the group.
source_quote: Join us on October 2nd from 4-9pm , for a hands-on Raku workshop where clay meets flame.
evidence_sentence: The page describes a Raku workshop with outdoor kiln demo and reduction chamber experience.
evidence_quote: Join us on October 2nd from 4-9pm , for a hands-on Raku workshop where clay meets flame. In this workshop, you'll learn the basics of the Raku firing process—from glazing to pulling red-hot pots from the kiln and plunging them into combustibles for stunning effects.
